Romain ROUYER commented on NTX BIR 2022: "Les prochaines consignes pour l'organisation du BIR 2022 :

If you haven't already, please take a look at the BIR2022 Chapter Organization Package. All the resources related to the BIR2022 organization can be found in this single document which will be added as we prepare more material.
<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZYXWpjHbRmP_iPBZ3JhXS_qlpoTbB8sx6HjhtM5RlAI/edit?usp=sharing>

The goal and focus of the BIR remains the same, kick off the year for your chapter community with review of 2021.

A few modifications to the format:
- Each chapter will be hosting one BIR
- Chapters can collaborate for the organization as well as presentation.
Our emphasis on each chapter hosting an event was to ensure that we strive to deeply serve each NTX Chapter community (e.g., strive for maximized attendance within one community not across multiple), be it online or virtual.
- In addition to each event's networking, Connectome Committee will be hosting 4 Global Networking events spread across the event series which will possibly include company booths, presentations, startup pitches.

The immediate steps ahead of us are: Expected time taken for these tasks (~30 minutes)
- All chapters reserving a date for their event here: <https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15ZW4BVSyCmoStd1-qzSHI3zEbHaN70sz3vjpx9Xphjk/edit?usp=sharing> (same link available in BIR2022 Chapter Organization Package)
- Taking the meetup events online on each chapter meetup: Save the date with more details to follow for attendees. (The placeholder poster and meetup boiler plate text is available in the BIR2022 Chapter Organization Package. <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZYXWpjHbRmP_iPBZ3JhXS_qlpoTbB8sx6HjhtM5RlAI/edit?usp=sharing)>
- Please take a judgement call about the COVID situation in your city and whether the event will be online/in-person. Attendee safety always comes first!

We will be sending out the sponsorship package by the end of this month so you can start reaching out to potential sponsors.

Connectome committee will begin inviting global sponsors at the same time and hence it would be great to have the meetup events online.
We can use this channel to discuss any doubts, ideas and organization stuff. Please feel free to reach out to @Mohit Patil @Sydney Sue if you would like any specific support or info.
Hope everyone has a great rest of the week!"

Pour nous rejoindre en directe
1. Prenez un billet sur <https://paris.makerfaire.com/>
2. Cherchez nous dans la liste des “EXPOSANTS” > section “Makers Exposants” et cherchez dans la liste ou indiquez ‘CogLab’ dans la recherche
3. Rejoignez-nous dans une salle en direct ou à défaut vous pouvez réserver un créneaux de discussion
